title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: For one call to the model in your makerspace assistant, which of these counts toward the context window?

options.text: Only the student's latest message and the model's reply
Instructions, tool descriptions, history, tool results and the reply
Only what the model learned in training plus the latest message
Everything every student has ever typed into the assistant before

items.stem: A student passes laser-cutter training on Monday. Next week they start a brand-new chat with your assistant. What must your program do for the assistant to know about the pass?

options.text: Nothing, because the model keeps what it has seen from every chat
Nothing, because a larger context window carries over across chats
Save the status when it happens, then load it into the new chat
Retrieve the status from the machine manuals when it is needed

items.stem: In one request, your program makes 3 model calls. Each call sends the full input again. Call 1 input: instructions and question, 1,050 tokens. The model's reply to call 1 is 50 tokens, and a tool result of 200 tokens is then added. Call 2 sends everything so far. Its reply is another 50 tokens, and a tool result of 300 tokens is added. Call 3 sends everything so far. How many input tokens are read in total across the 3 calls? Count input tokens only, not replies as output.
Your machine manuals total 3,000,000 tokens and a student asks about one lathe setting. Which design best keeps cost low and answers reliable?

options.text: Search the manuals and put only the matching pages in context
Put the whole manual in context so that nothing is ever missed
Switch to the model with the biggest window and send it all
Remove the instructions so the manual takes up the whole window

items.stem: A research agent has run 60 steps and its window is 90% full, mostly old tool results it has already used. The task must go on. Which change is best for recall and cost?

options.text: Keep going unchanged, since the model remembers it better than you do
Move to a larger window and keep every old result in the input
End the session and start again with no record of earlier work
Save key findings as notes, clear old results and keep a summary
